notes.title: Trading Cards Now Available
notes.content:
Hello Lemonaders,

We've now got trading cards!

[i]Series 1[/i] starts with a base pack of five cards.
[list]
    [*]Andre
    [*]Liselot
    [*]Mr Amsterdaam
    [*]Working Man Hero
    [*]Model sheets
[/list]

Collect them all!

Also, have you ever wanted to make your own level for [b]Super Lemonade Factory[/b]? You can, using the same tools as the dev to make custom levels.

Getting started is pretty easy. You can watch [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IDLqinZKixE] this YouTube video and see me make a level	 [/url]

Or, here are the instructions:

Find the file [i]"C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\SuperLemonadeFactory\SLF_levelEditor.zip"[/i] and unzip it.

Install the Ogmo Editor 0.918 from the folder ogmoEditor/ogmoEditor.air.

OR 

Download the Ogmo Editor from http://ogmoeditor.com/download/OgmoEditor.air

You'll need to download the Ogmo Editor version 0.918. This project may not work with Ogmo Editor v2.x.
The Ogmo Editor is a free and open source level editor created by Matt Thorson. It will run on Windows, Linux and OSX.

The Ogmo Editor requires Adobe Air. If you don't have Adobe Air installed, download it from Adobe's website. 

Once installed, open it up and go to File > Open Project.
Open the file _SuperLemonadeFactory.oep

From here you can open existing levels or create your own.
